```{r}
#load data from leptin treated

#load data from WT
```

```{r no bc, eval=FALSE}
arc.combined = merge(arc_leptin,c(arc_ob, arc_wt))
dim(arc.combined)
#[1] 24599 12326

arc.combined = ScaleData(arc.combined, verbose = FALSE)

arc.combined <- RunPCA(arc.combined, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)

saveRDS(arc.combined, file = paste0(save_dir, "arc.combined_non_bc_111621.RDS"))
```

```{R batch_correction}
#integrate the three conditions with batch corrected 
arc.list = list(arc_ob, arc_wt, arc_leptin)

#Slc32a1 is in the expression
all_genes <- lapply(arc.list, row.names) %>% Reduce(intersect, .)

#"Slc32a1" does not in top 4000 variable genes
arc.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = arc.list, anchor.features = all_genes)

#renaming 
arc.combined <- IntegrateData(anchorset = arc.anchors, features = all_genes)

#standard RNA processing
#arc.combined[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(arc.combined, pattern = "^MT-", assay = 'RNA')
DefaultAssay(arc.combined) = "integrated"
arc.combined = ScaleData(arc.combined, verbose = FALSE)
arc.combined <- RunPCA(arc.combined, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)
#arc.combined <- JackStraw(arc.combined, dims = 30)
#arc.combined <- ScoreJackStraw(arc.combined,dims=1:30)
#JackStrawPlot(arc.combined, dims = 1:30)
ElbowPlot(arc.combined) #take 30PC
arc.combined <- RunUMAP(arc.combined, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
arc.combined <- FindNeighbors(arc.combined, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
arc.combined <- FindClusters(arc.combined, resolution = 0.55)

#hashtag1 ARCH3H, hashtag2 PVH3H, hashtag5 ARCH24h, hashtag6 PVH24h, hashtag7 ARCH72h, hashtag8 PVH72H 
arc.combined@meta.data$time = ''
hashtag_list = paste0('Hashtag',c(1,5,7, 2,6,8))
reg_time = c(paste0('ARC', c('3h', '24h','72h')),paste0('PVH', c('3h', '24h','72h')))
conv_table =data.frame(hashtag_list, reg_time)

for (i in 1:3) {
  arc.combined@meta.data[which(arc.combined@meta.data$orig.ident == "leptin" & arc.combined@meta.data$Hashtag_classification == conv_table$hashtag_list[i]),  'time'] = conv_table$reg_time[i]
}

arc.combined@meta.data$condition = paste0(arc.combined@meta.data$orig.ident, arc.combined@meta.data$time)

p1 <- DimPlot(arc.combined, reduction = "umap", group.by = "condition")
p2 <- DimPlot(arc.combined, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE)
p1 + p2

#plot by cell percentage
ggplot(arc.combined@meta.data, aes(x=seurat_clusters, fill=condition)) + geom_bar(position = "fill") + theme_bw()

#specific gene expression
#look at one gene
my_cols = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(5, "Paired")
VlnPlot(arc.combined, features = "Lepr", split.by = "condition", group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0, combine = FALSE, cols = my_cols)

#look at all the arc markers
arc_markers = c("Slc17a6", "Slc32a1", "Gad1", "Lepr", "Npy", "Pomc", "Bnc2", "Sst", "Ghrh", "Th", "Pnoc","Agrp", "Magel2")
VlnPlot(arc.combined, features = arc_markers, pt.size = 0, same.y.lims = TRUE, stack = TRUE, flip = TRUE)
saveRDS(arc.combined, file =paste0(save_dir, "arc.combined_112421.RDS"))

#split by conditions
```

```{r construct gene regulatory network}
library(epoch)
library(singleCellNet)

arc.combined = readRDS(paste0(save_dir, "arc.combined_111621.RDS"))
sampTab = read.csv("metadata_arc_pt.csv")
rownames(sampTab) = as.vector(sampTab$cellID)

#find HVG
arc.combined <- FindVariableFeatures(arc.combined , selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 4000)

expDat<-arc.combined@assays$RNA@counts
expDat = expDat[rowSums(expDat)!=0,] #remove dropout genes

# Find TFs
mmTFs<-utils_loadObject(paste0(save_dir,"/mmTFs.rda"))
#mmTFs<-intersect(rownames(expDat),mmTFs)

# Only look at specific cluster
cluster = 17
sampTab_neuron = sampTab[which(sampTab$seurat_clusters %in% c(cluster)),]
sampTab_neuron$velocity_pseudotime_scaled = (sampTab_neuron$velocity_pseudotime - min(sampTab_neuron$velocity_pseudotime)) / (max(sampTab_neuron$velocity_pseudotime) - min(sampTab_neuron$velocity_pseudotime))

expDat_neuron = as.matrix(expDat[VariableFeatures(arc.combined),rownames(sampTab_neuron)])
#downsample and log-transform data

expDat_neuron = trans_prop(expDat_neuron, total = 10000, dThresh = 0.25)
expDat_neuron = expDat_neuron[rowSums(expDat_neuron)>0,]
mmTFs<-intersect(rownames(expDat_neuron),mmTFs)

# Find dynamically expressed genes
xdyn <- findDynGenes(expDat_neuron, sampTab_neuron, group_column="seurat_clusters", pseudotime_column="velocity_pseudotime_scaled")
pThresh<-0.01
dgenes<-names(xdyn$genes)[xdyn$genes<pThresh]

# Reconstruct and perform crossweighting
grnDF <- reconstructGRN(expDat_neuron, mmTFs, dgenes, method="pearson", zThresh=3)
grnDF <- crossweight(grnDF,expDat_neuron,xdyn,filter_thresh=0)

xdyn<-define_epochs(xdyn,expDat_neuron,method="pseudotime",num_epochs=3)
epoch_assignments<-assign_epochs(expDat_neuron,xdyn)
dynamic_grn<-epochGRN(grnDF,epoch_assignments)

#influential TFs
gene_rank<-compute_pagerank(dynamic_grn,weight_column="weighted_score")
another_gene_rank<-compute_betweenness_degree(dynamic_grn,weight_column="weighted_score")

#add interactions
dynamic_grn<-add_interaction_type(dynamic_grn)
community_assignments<-find_communities(dynamic_grn)

# First, smooth expression for a cleaner plot
ccells <- xdyn$cells
expSmoothed <- grnKsmooth(expDat_neuron, ccells, BW=0.03)

# Plot a heatmap of the dynamic TFs
tfstoplot<-intersect(dgenes  ,mmTFs)
dynTFs<-xdyn
dynTFs$genes<-dynTFs$genes[names(dynTFs$genes) %in% tfstoplot]

pdf(paste0("~/Desktop/arc_cluster",cluster, "_top20_dynamicTF.pdf"))
hm_dyn(expSmoothed,dynTFs,topX=20)
dev.off()

#plot dynamic network
pdf(paste0("~/Desktop/arc_cluster", cluster, "_dynamicGRN.pdf"))
plot_dynamic_network(dynamic_grn,mmTFs,only_TFs=TRUE,order=c("epoch1..epoch1","epoch2..epoch2","epoch3..epoch3"))
dev.off()

pdf(paste0("~/Desktop/arc_cluster",cluster,"_top5TFs.pdf"))
plot_top_regulators(dynamic_grn, gene_rank, mmTFs, numTopTFs=5, only_TFs=FALSE,order=c("epoch1..epoch1","epoch2..epoch2","epoch3..epoch3"))
dev.off()
```
